metadata.title: Quick Start - The Regrid Property App (Web)
metadata.author: Regrid
metadata.shortDescription:
Guide to the main features in the web version of the Regrid Property App to get you up and using the site quickly and easily.

Did you know that we also offer a companion mobile app for your phone or tablet? Simply search Regrid Property App on iOS App Store or Google Play Store to download. A Regrid Pro subscription gets you full access to both web and mobile app versions: sign up for a Pro subscription at https://app.regrid.com/plans
